MUSHROOM HUNT — FREE PBR TEXTURE SOURCES
======================================
Textures from Poly Haven, CC0 1.0 Universal (public domain dedication):
https://polyhaven.com/license
https://polyhaven.com/a/forrest_ground_01  — forest floor: diffuse and OpenGL normal, 2K JPG
https://polyhaven.com/a/mossy_rock        — mossy rocks: diffuse and OpenGL normal, 2K JPG
https://polyhaven.com/a/bark_brown_02     — bark: diffuse and OpenGL normal, 1K JPG

The installer downloads these six image files directly from the Poly Haven CDN.
These image files are part of the finished Unity project (not downloaded at game runtime).
Actual file license: Creative Commons CC0 1.0 Universal.
Original authored game scene, assets and scripts: user's mushroomgame repository.
WRAD FPS hands: https://github.com/wwwriks/wrad-arms, CC0 1.0 Universal.
